title: Cedwyn programme: Welsh estate reconstruction and heritage Snowball
band_rule: Progress is published only in four bands: 0%+ (initiated), 33%+ (first deliverable live), 66%+ (paid v0.0.2 releases live or the physical/field pilot running), 100% (closed and handed over). Bands are set by stage evidence, not task counts. Detailed tasks live in the task board, not here.
flywheel: The Snowball is the programme-wide recursive operating model: source recovery, canonical records, parcel/person/event relationships, independent challenge, resolved research gaps, approved public and documentary outputs, and transparent reinvestment. Existing Projects A–D boundaries remain intact. Every smaller loop is subordinate to the master protocol; HubSpot owns work, GitHub owns versioned source, Hive coordinates and public outputs are approved.

projects.name: Wales research
projects.scope: The evidence and artifact catalogue for Great House Farm / Tŷ Mawr (Cydfin Farm), Llandough: records recovery, disclosure requests, testimony, the chronology, and the search for the trigger event (concealment, irregularity or government involvement) that would meet the legal bar.

spin_offs.name: Case reopening gate
spin_offs.state: STANDBY — not initiated until a ground meets every limb of the legal test and the Executive authorises it

projects.band_evidence: Evidence catalogue, missing-records register and disclosure tracker are live; the trigger event is not met.
projects.was: P2 Wales records and testimony recovery + P4 Case reopening

projects.name: Online legacy family estate (digital asset)
projects.scope: Everything published from the research: the documentary and the later AI-generated film, the online slideshow tour (formerly the bpvsbuckler story), the shop, a press pack, games and e-books.
projects.band_evidence: Documentary doors, slideshow tour, shop, games and e-books are live as v0.0.1; e-books also offer v0.0.2; no sale recorded yet; press pack not live.

projects.name: Argentina: physical replica Great House and Cedwyn Estate 2.0
projects.scope: A researched replica of the house and a museum on land in southern Argentina (Chubut), built from the research record.
projects.band_evidence: Concept and research inputs only; no site selected, acquired or approved.

projects.name: Wales: guided virtual and augmented group tour
projects.scope: Guided group tour in public places only: the Peerless Jim and Marconi statues in Cardiff, and the view from Church View Close and the woods at Llandough, with virtual and augmented layers.
projects.band_evidence: Browser tour and stop research exist; no pilot walk booked; no AR prototype.
projects.was: P3 Parcel A AR guided tour (scope now public areas only)

risks.risk: Hosting limits: the static host is at about 90% of its file cap and the free database tier is at its database count and daily read limit.
risks.response: Reduce: architecture decision ADR-002 (one catalogue in git, compiled at build; no new files per page; no runtime database queries for the read layer).

risks.risk: Evidence data held in several overlapping stores, so pages can disagree.
risks.response: Reduce: one master catalogue; the other stores become build outputs (work package 2).

risks.risk: No revenue yet, so the flywheel has no fuel for the research.
risks.response: Reduce: v0.0.2 releases per deliverable; measure weekly.

risks.risk: Paid releases may need per-image permission from archives.
risks.response: Avoid: archive images unchanged and free tier only until permission is held.

risks.risk: Many automated contributors working on the same site at once.
risks.response: Reduce: single build owner for main; task board for detail; per-page journals.

issues.issue: Programme re-baselined on 30 October 2026: four projects; former P2 and P4 merged into Project A (P4 as spin-off A1); new Project B.
Project D scope changed to public places only (Cardiff statues, Church View Close view, Llandough woods); earlier in-situ wording superseded.
Header graphs of some webapps plotted pages instead of their own data; correction under way (Dartboard first).
Each page's footer showed a site-wide change log, not that page's own journal; per-page journal planned.

Cedwyn Snowball master programme added on 31 October 2026: one HubSpot parent task and ten specialist packages, with Projects/Agent Library/Hive as shared entry points. Existing four-project structure remains intact.
